summary: Static review found three narrow false-pass gaps in sentinel and protocol validation. Source-copy and bundle provenance checks are substantial, and package/upgrade limitations explicitly leave connectivity, distribution readiness and rollback unverified. No candidate code or tests were executed.

findings.claim: [P2] The required sentinel test can be satisfied by a different test whose name merely starts with the required name. The regex has a boundary before SENTINEL_TEST but accepts any trailing characters. Consequently, a skipped required case plus a passing case named testSmokeStartupPreservesLiveFixtureEndpointAndAllSentinelStateWithoutEndpoint would produce sentinelPreserved=true.
findings.recommendation: Match the exact XCTest case identifier and its closing delimiter before the passed result. Add a regression case where the required test is skipped and a suffixed test passes.

findings.claim: [P2] Package sentinel preservation ignores newly created fixture state. The verifier compares only the original eight files, socket and lease. A smoke regression can create evidence.sqlite-wal, an extra export, a settings sidecar or a new directory under the supplied fixture and still receive sentinelPreserved=true when the original entries remain unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Capture and compare the entire fixture tree before and after the packaged checks, including entry paths and types, while retaining the existing socket-connectivity and lease checks. Add a focused regression for an unexpected new fixture file.

findings.claim: [P2] The helper protocol checker accepts structurally incomplete successful responses. Its own accepted fixture has no initialization capabilities or server version and advertises a tool without inputSchema. Such a catalog cannot establish that a client can consume the advertised tool definition. Additionally, Python equality lets a JSON boolean response id true satisfy expected request id 1.
findings.recommendation: Validate the required shapes and types of these existing initialization/list/ping responses, including exact integer IDs, initialization metadata/capabilities and each tool's inputSchema. This requires no evidence query or expansion into actual app connectivity.

eligibility_reason: Candidate review requires parent reconciliation before acceptance; static review is not final runtime validation.
risks: Scratch and build products are retained locally with no aggregate scratch-size limit or cleanup policy in these files. Input, bundle and log limits do not cap compiler intermediates or accumulation across repeated runs.
CI preserves hashes and logs but not the actual app bundle. Artifact identity can be recorded, while later retrieval of that exact binary depends on separate retention.

Process-group termination covers descendants that remain in the owned group; it is not containment for deliberately detached or hostile processes. This matches the stated non-hostile fixture-isolation contract.
Actual app MCP queries, scale, overnight behavior, native-client behavior, signing, installation and downgrade rollback remain outside this review and are not claimed verified.
